steps.description:
The "Wait Until Color" block waits until a certain colour is detected before running the next block. You can choose any colour from the list. However, select only Red, Green, Blue, Orange or White as the sensor can only detect these colours.



You are building a Colour Guessing Game.

Ask your friend to flash 4 different colours in order. If they hear a sound every time they pick a colour, they win.

Using the blocks below (you may duplicate any block), create the game so that when the colours Orange, Blue, Green, and Red are flashed in that exact order, a sound is played after each one.
